record_title: Single-value p-adic peeling of cyclotomic index radicals
provenance: Exact p-adic residual factorization of the cyclotomic Möbius product after radical reduction.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.18480v1 is extremely recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. Its relevant local extractor, squarefree factor-stripping, and Archimedean peeling statements were inspected, as were the classical Möbius-product, radical-reduction, and first-gap results of Pomerance--Rubinstein-Salzedo. No inaccessible source was identified whose available metadata specifically suggests the same normalized residual p-adic recursion. The binary corollary here covers nonsquarefree indices; squarefree indices at base 2 fall outside the sign-recovery hypothesis. The index and base are assumed known. The verification artifact is supporting evidence and not a substitute for the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
